hamburg-l-neburg-heath-flow.title: Hamburg · Lüneburg Heath Flow
hamburg-l-neburg-heath-flow.slogan: A 140 km loop out of Buchholz
hamburg-l-neburg-heath-flow.story: Heather, pine forest and clean southbound rhythm without city crawling. 140 km round from Buchholz in der Nordheide - plan on about 2 h 25 of riding. It goes by way of Wilsede heath core, Lüneburg old town meal stop and Elbe marsh. It keeps to quiet secondary roads.

scenicChapters.title: Route des Vins d'Alsace
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 71 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go. Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

The stops in between: La Manufacture à Saint- Dié, La place forte de Neuf-Brisach, Strasbourg and back through La place forte de Neuf-Brisach. The highest point is about 800 m. It suits an unhurried touring pace.
